name: Alto
source:
Masato is an average student. One day, his parents go abroad on business for a month. Like this, he suddenly starts living alone. It is relaxing and comfortable at first, but.... He unexpectedly loses most of the money his parents left to cover his living expenses.

Following advice from one of his buddies, Masato applies for a part-time catering job at a family restaurant. There, he happens to meet one of his classmates, Megumi, who happens to be a popular figure at school and someone Masato admires from afar. Her sister Saori also works at the same place.

At the same time, Masato receives an unforeseen sollicitation from student council vice-president and classmate Miharu to help in various tasks, in exchange for free meals.

Thus, Masato's uneventful school life begins to move...

[Edited from ErogeShop summary]
translation:
真人是一名普通學生。某天，他的父母因公出國一個月，於是他突然開始獨自生活。起初，這樣的日子輕鬆又自在，可是……他意外弄丟了父母留下的大部分生活費。

在朋友的建議下，真人應徵到一間家庭餐廳打工。在那裡，他偶然遇見同班同學惠。惠是學校裡的風雲人物，也是他一直遠遠仰慕的對象。她的姊姊沙織也在同一家店工作。

與此同時，學生會副會長兼同班同學美春突然找上真人，請他幫忙處理各種事務，並以免費供餐作為交換。

就這樣，真人一成不變的校園生活開始向前轉動……

[改寫自ErogeShop簡介]
